decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Underworld Breach and Hullbreacher to generate card advantage and mana advantage, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in a single turn and potentially win the game quickly. The deck includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Tinker to support the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies with counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The goal is to efficiently dig through the deck with draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to set up the combo and protect it with countermagic while disrupting the opponent.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggression and midrange control through the use of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Deathrite Shaman and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds flexibility and resilience to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck seeks to establish dominance on the battlefield and control the game tempo.

The main concept of this Combo-Dredge deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Golgari Grave-Troll, and Stinkweed Imp, and then use cards like Ichorid, Prized Amalgam, and Silversmote Ghoul to bring back creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption and protection with cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to ensure the combo can go off without interruption. Additionally, cards like Creeping Chill provide extra damage and Noxious Revival can help ensure key combo pieces are available.

The main strategy of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and card selection with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise. Utilizing powerful mana acceleration through Moxes and Black Lotus, the deck can quickly get ahead on board while controlling the game with a combination of permission spells and removal. The inclusion of the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value and recursion for the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing Coveted Jewel along with other artifact ramp and card draw spells to quickly assemble a powerful combo. By generating large amounts of mana and drawing through the deck with cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge, the player aims to win the game by creating infinite turns with Time Vault and Voltaic Key or overwhelming their opponent with the massive advantage from Coveted Jewel. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator adds additional utility and disruption options to the strategy.

The deck is focused on using control elements and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the Dimir Control deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion, while key cards like Force of Will, Ancestral Recall, and Dig Through Time provide powerful control options. Overall, the deck seeks to outsmart and outlast the opponent through efficient resource management and strategic play.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counter spells, targeted removal, and card advantage to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by recurring key cards from the graveyard. The deck aims to control the game through disruption and card advantage, while efficiently dealing with threats and developing its own board presence. With a mix of powerful spells and efficient creatures, this deck is built to consistently outplay opponents and control the tempo of the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Brainstorm to maintain card advantage and control the game. With a mix of counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, along with removal like Fatal Push, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own. Utilizing cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den for additional value, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents with a combination of control elements and powerful threats.

The main concept of this combo Dredge deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Creeping Chill, Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Golgari Thug using Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. These cards are then used to trigger powerful abilities from cards like Prized Amalgam, Hollow One, and Silversmote Ghoul. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to protect the combo and slow down the opponent. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless graveyard-based strategy while also having answers to their plays.

The main strategy of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Bazaar Aggro deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Basking Rootwalla and Squee, Goblin Nabob to bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One. Utilizing powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as card recursion with Noxious Revival and Master of Death, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and deny them the ability to effectively counter your game plan.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and colorless creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive play. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration from artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly deploy threats like Arcbound Ravager, Steel Overseer, and Walking Ballista. Cards like Chalice of the Void, Thorn of Amethyst, Sphere of Resistance, and Trinisphere help disrupt the opponent's game plan while keeping the pressure on. The deck also includes utility lands like Mishra's Workshop and Wasteland to further control the game. Overall, the deck aims to race ahead of the opponent and close out games quickly with its efficient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for various forms of card advantage, disruption, and control over the opponent's plays. It combines powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional card recursion and value over time. Overall, the deck aims to continuously disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and eventually overwhelm them with its powerful threats and control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage through artifacts and spells like Paradoxical Outcome. By using cards like Grim Monolith, Phyrexian Metamorph, and Coveted Jewel, the goal is to quickly assemble a powerful board state and win the game through a combo involving Time Vault and Mana Crypt. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy help ensure the deck has enough mana to quickly execute its game plan and overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Time Vault combo using cards like Voltaic Key, Manifold Key, and Karn, the Great Creator. By generating mana with Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb, the deck can quickly cast Paradoxical Outcome to draw cards and set up the combo. Coveted Jewel can also serve as a secondary win condition by generating card advantage. Force of Will and other disruption cards help protect the combo pieces while Trinisphere slows down opponents. Overall, the deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifacts.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan using counter spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, as well as removal spells such as Fatal Push and Strip Mine. It also utilizes card advantage with draw spells like Brainstorm and Ancestral Recall, while also able to tutor for key cards with Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor. The deck aims to control the game through disruption, card advantage, and efficient removal, ultimately outlasting the opponent and securing victory through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Collector Ouphe, Deathrite Shaman, Leovold, Emissary of Trest, and Oko, Thief of Crowns. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Abrupt Decay, Force of Vigor, and Force of Will to control the game. The deck has a strong mana base with fetch lands and powerful artifact ramp like Black Lotus. It aims to establish an aggressive board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan to achieve victory.
